title: Implement Parquet store writer and reader
objective: A ParquetStore class can write wide-format DataFrames to partitioned Parquet files and read them back with date-range filtering

methods.name: read
methods.signature: (self, symbols: list[str], start: datetime, end: datetime) -> pd.DataFrame | None
methods.returns: Wide-format DataFrame or None if no data exists

methods.name: get_cached_ranges
methods.returns: List of (start, end) tuples representing cached date ranges

methods.name: find_missing_ranges
methods.signature: (self, symbols: list[str], start: datetime, end: datetime) -> list[tuple[datetime, datetime]]
methods.returns: List of (start, end) tuples not yet cached

acceptance_criteria: write() creates a Parquet file at predictable path based on timeframe and date
read() returns DataFrame with UTC DatetimeIndex
read() returns None when no cached data exists
read() filters to requested date range
Written and read DataFrames are equal (round-trip fidelity)
DatetimeIndex is timezone-aware UTC after read
get_cached_ranges returns correct ranges after writes
